title: Cohort and denominators by release year
definition: All 36,249 PRIDE datasets released 2013–2025. Standard result files = corrected non-generated expanded mzIdentML/mzTab definition. Identifiable results = file names, archive members and table headers; rule-based detection with unmeasured sensitivity and false-positive rates. Contributor group = hashed PI contact.

title: Effective number of categories by axis and release year (Fig. 1a)
definition: Inverse Simpson index of category shares among each year’s datasets; fractional credit for multiple categories; 95% intervals by bootstrap over contributor groups (300 replicates). Contributor-group diversity is descriptive; its intervals are omitted.

title: Breadth of the archive: 2023–25 vs 2013–15 at three diversity orders (Fig. 1b)
definition: Hill numbers: order 2 = inverse Simpson, order 1 = exp(Shannon), order 0 = richness rarefied to the smaller period’s dataset count (mean of 50 subsamples). Ratios with 95% intervals from bootstrap over contributor groups within each period (orders 1 and 2; 300 replicates). Instrument models harmonised as in the fleet analysis; vendors are the harmonised models’ vendors; contributor groups credit each dataset to its group. Contributor-group diversity is descriptive; its intervals are omitted.

title: Concentration of datasets and bytes across contributor groups (Supplementary Fig. 1)
definition: Shares supplied by the largest groups, by period; Gini coefficients; 95% bootstrap over groups.

title: Datasets, groups and bytes by group size class (Supplementary Fig. 1)
Countries: growth, international co-authorship and data age (Fig. 1e–g; Supplementary Figs 10–11)
definition: Datasets by contributing group’s country (country-resolved datasets only). Growth multiple 2016–18 → 2023–25 with 95% group-bootstrap interval. International share = linked papers with author institutions in ≥2 countries. Data age = days from latest acquisition date in raw-file names to submission, Thermo-only non-DIA datasets submitted 2016–2025.

title: Instrument models: datasets, life cycle and run size (Figs 2d, 3a; Supplementary Figs 2–3)
definition: Models named in ≥50 datasets. peak_share and share_2025 are unweighted proportions of model-labelled datasets naming the model; a dataset naming several models counts once for each. peak_year_share is the year of the largest unweighted proportion. These differ from the fractional-credit shares in Fig. 3a and Supplementary Fig. 2. first_year_any and first_year_ge5 use ≥1 and ≥5 datasets, respectively; Supplementary Fig. 2 orders models by the first year with ≥3 datasets. datasets/groups_total count all deposits/groups naming the model. run_size_datasets/run_size_groups count the single-model subset with exact run counts and positive resolved bytes per run; summaries require ≥50 eligible datasets. Within this subset, median_runs is the median exact run count; median_per_run_GB and p25/p75 are the median and 25th/75th percentiles of dataset-level resolved bytes divided by exact run count, in GB (10^9 bytes); dia_share is the fraction with DIA detected. Blank run-size fields mean the model did not meet the subset threshold. A deposited label is not an ownership record.

title: Raw runs per dataset, 2013–16 vs 2023–25, under alternative definitions (Fig. 2c)
definition: Median ratio and change in the share with ≥100 runs, with 95% group-bootstrap intervals.

title: Standard result files by analysis tool and export capability (Fig. 4a–b)
definition: Single-tool datasets. Export capability from the software registry (Software-registry.md): default = tool writes mzIdentML/mzTab by default; built-in = option; none = cannot.

title: Standard result files by export capability, with 95% group-bootstrap intervals (Fig. 4b)
Age of the software release at public release, by tool (Supplementary Fig. 5)
definition: Years from the first PRIDE submission recording the exact release to public release of the dataset (a lower bound); medians with group-bootstrap intervals; ceilings = oldest release of the tool in PRIDE.

title: Software release lines in 2025 submissions (Supplementary Fig. 4)
definition: Share of datasets with a recovered version.

title: What travels with the data, by release year and reading depth (Fig. 4c–d)
definition: Percent of datasets. before = top-level file names; after = adding archive members; with_headers = adding table headers.

title: Documentation persistence within contributor groups (Fig. 4e)
definition: Next dataset of the same group carrying the file, by whether the previous dataset did, vs the expected rate for datasets of the same years.

title: Clocks of a deposit: medians with 95% group-bootstrap intervals (Fig. 5a)
definition: acq = latest acquisition date in raw file names; db = date in the main FASTA name; sw = first PRIDE submission recording the software release (lower bound); sub = submission; rel = public release; paper = OpenAlex publication date.

title: Release relative to the linked paper, bulk release days vs other days (Supplementary Fig. 13)
Journals of dataset-linked papers (Fig. 5b–c)
definition: Top 15 journals by linked datasets and share of each year’s linked papers.

title: Concentration of dataset-linked papers across journals by year (Fig. 5c)
Non-primary cross-group accession mentions: standardised rates by feature (Fig. 5d)
definition: D1 = non-primary mention in release year or next three calendar years by a paper naming 2 or more contributor groups and at most 100 datasets. Same-year chronology is unresolved. D2 = publication-year lag at least 2, excluding primary papers linked to another deposit of the same group; D3 = both. D1_all removes the 100-dataset ceiling. Rates directly standardised over release-year by human-status strata, with 1000 group-bootstrap draws; empty strata omitted and weights renormalised. Thermo Fisher only denotes instrument-vendor assignment.

title: Reuse: adjusted odds ratios and robustness checks (Fig. 5e)
definition: Ridge binomial logit GLM with alpha 1e-4 and L1_wt 0; 2000 contributor-group bootstrap draws. Predictors: standard files, detected DIA, SDRF, human and Thermo Fisher-only vendor assignment. Adjustment: release year, pooled field/software categories, log10 bytes floored at 1e6, log(1+citations) and missing-citation indicator. See Supplementary Methods for missingness and category reference levels. A4/A5 report crude rate ratios with 1000 group-bootstrap draws. A5 uses release year plus five calendar years among 2013-2020 releases. SDRF direction is not interpretable because files may be added after release.

title: Findings ledger: every result with its robustness status
definition: Historical review ledger: V verified in the original review; W weakened; S single analysis; X dropped. These labels are not independent validation. Corrected wording includes later reporting qualifications and supersedes historical claims. The 107 rows are not 107 freshly rerun tests. Source: Findings-ledger.md.

title: Supporting numerical comparisons
definition: Reported comparisons supporting the Results. Values retain manuscript rounding; source tables retain full precision. Bounds are explicitly labelled as 95% intervals or observed/estimated ranges. Blank bounds mean no interval was reported here, not zero uncertainty. This is a curated reporting table, not a new analysis.
